mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as it reflects a more accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the discount rate for equity valuations.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low-rate environments are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI reading above 3.5% (CPIAUCSL) signals persistent inflation that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5%), or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is negative.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous acceleration in private employment growth (PAYEMS) and consumer spending (RSAFS) signals robust economic expansion that reduces recession risk and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (PAYEMS and RSAFS both rising) fails to produce positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a regression model.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion regimes, a strong manufacturing supply (INDPRO above 105) signals overcapacity and impending economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO above 105 in late-cycle expansion regimes does not lead to negative 60-day returns in > 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is positive.

mechanism_narrative: A higher unemployment rate (UNRATE) is associated with lower S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as it reflects economic weakness that reduces corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in high-unemployment environments are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts rate below 1500.0 thousand units (HOUST) signals a contraction in the housing sector that reduces consumer confidence and corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (HOUST < 1500.0), or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is negative.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and a decline in unemployment (UNRATE) signals an aggressive monetary tightening cycle during a tight labor market, which increases the risk of a recession and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (FEDFUNDS rising and UNRATE falling) fails to produce negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a regression model.

mechanism_narrative: During early-cycle expansion regimes, a strong quarterly GDP growth rate (GDPC1 > 2.0%) signals robust economic momentum that supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth above 2.0% in early-cycle expansion regimes does not lead to positive 60-day returns in > 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is negative.
